# Jane Blakeley

Jane Blakeley has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jane-blakeley#e20)

## Election History

### 2014 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Brelade No 2](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade-no-2) (2 seats), 15th October 2014.

**Jane Blakeley was not elected**.
